tools.name: audit_cloud_security
tools.description: Audits a target GCP asset state (GCS bucket, KMS key, firewall rule, IAM binding) against ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Control A.5.23.

resource_type.description: The category of cloud resource to audit.

resource_name.description: Full resource name or identifier (e.g. bucket-name, projects/.../cryptoKeys/...).

config.description: Optional dictionary containing configuration attributes for audit analysis.

tools.name: scan_iac_configuration
tools.description: Static analysis of Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible) to detect misconfigurations before deployment per ISO 27001 Control A.8.9.

content.description: Raw text content of the IaC file.

tools.name: correlate_threat_intelligence
tools.description: Correlates cloud audit logging trails with active threat intelligence (Google SecOps / Mandiant) per ISO 27001 Control A.5.7.

log_sink_name.description: Name of the Cloud Logging sink.

sink_destination.description: Destination URI of the sink (e.g. BigQuery dataset).

recent_events.description: List of recent audit log event dictionaries.

threat_feed_enabled.description: Whether active threat intelligence feed is active.

tools.name: audit_climate_resilience
tools.description: Audits geographic distribution, active-active failover, and climate disaster recovery resilience per ISO 27001:2022 Amd 1:2024 (Clauses 4.1 & 4.2).

workload_id.description: Identifier of the critical workload or service.

topology.description: Topology details including primary_region, secondary_region, storage_redundancy, automated_failover.

climate_risk_assessed.description: Whether climate risk was evaluated in ISMS context.

tools.name: audit_data_leakage_prevention
tools.description: Audits VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters, egress policies, and data boundaries per ISO 27001 Control A.8.12.

tools.name: audit_monitoring_activities
tools.description: Audits centralized logging into BigQuery/SecOps and retention per ISO 27001 Control A.8.16.
